newsitem.title: NORWAY: Orkla shares jump on improved results.
newsitem.headline: Orkla shares jump on improved results.

text.p: Shares in Norwegian food, beverage, chemicals and media conglomerate Orkla ASA jumped after the group announced improved financial results for the first eight months.
At 1224 GMT Orkla's A share was trading at 370 crowns, five crowns up. The stock was unchanged from Wednesday's close just before the results were released.
Orkla booked a 16 percent rise in operating profits to 1.28 billion crowns compared with 1.11 billion crowns a year ago.
Profits before tax surged 26 percent to 1.75 billion crowns against 1.38 billion crowns in the corresponding 1995 period.
The results were slightly above analysts' expectations.
